candidates.name: Joule Capital Partners Utah campus gas interconnection to Kern River
aka: Joule Utah behind-the-meter campus gas supply line
candidates.from: Kern River Gas Transmission mainline, Millard County, Utah
candidates.to: Joule data center campus, Millard County (near Delta / Fillmore), Utah

evidence.note: Off-grid 12 GW campus plans redundant 36-inch interconnections with the Kern River mainline in Millard County; 1.4 GW by 2027, 12 GW by 2032. Pipe length unknown.
Joule 4,000-acre site, six buildings each with 69 Caterpillar gas generators; a June 2026 county vote on the gas pipeline was reported as pending

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster by name. Length unknown. Corridor is near but separate from P3856 Kern River Delta Lateral (Holden to Delta, IPP power plant). Possible overlap to be checked; no source ties the Joule line to that lateral. Kern River mainline is P0207.
